CustomField.description: Comma-separated Zoom user IDs (host_id) whose meetings and webinars the integration accepts. Webhook events and synced sessions hosted by anyone else are ignored, so classes and internal meetings on the same Zoom account never reach Salesforce. Blank = accept every host. Find a host ID in any Zoom meeting API response (field host_id).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Comma-separated Zoom host IDs, e.g. Vj58A57CQtWF3eN4trJaQg. Blank accepts all hosts.
CustomField.label: Allowed Host IDs
